♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 YI FIKILE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions leyi nga na **Your script** (xikiripiti xa wena) na **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, na **Flex Studio (Beta)** leyi dawuniloudiwaka ku sungula, yi tlhela yi ku vutisa yi nga si nghenisiwa.

*(Nghenisa ehenhla ka vhexini ya wena ya sweswi, kutani u sungula After Effects nakambe kan'we.)*

♦️ **Leswintshwa: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Xivumbeko xa **Map desk**, ku lavisisa tindhawu handle ka inthanete, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route na swin'wana), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, tindlela ta mapa ta mahala na **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Swipfuno swa yona swo engetela (ku hlanganisa hi nkarhi wolowo, tindlela, tilebula, 3D, Finalize) sweswi swi layicha hakunene endzeni ka After Effects.

♦️ **Leswintshwa eka AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ekhilawudini, yi tirhisa tikhrediti ta Flex AI) i injini leyi bumabumeriwaka, leyi hlawuriweke kan'we eka un'wana na un'wana. Hlawula Whisper nakambe leswaku u endla tikhepixini mahala eka khompyuta ya wena (Translate To yi lava Whisper). Loko sevha yi khomekile, u ta vona ndhawu ya wena eka layini.
* **Your script**: tikhepixini ti teka mapeletelo na marito ya xikiripiti hinkwako laha u vuleke marito wolawo.
* Vuhumelerisi bya **Editable template**: tikhepixini tanihi tileyara ta thempleti leti u ti cincaka xitayili eka Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* A ku hlawuriwanga nchumu naswona midiya ya xihlovo a yi na nchumu? Yi ta ku nyika **khomphozixini hinkwayo**. Mpfumawulo lowu fanaka wu tlhela wu tirhisa thiransikiripiti ya wona.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ya dawuniloda, kutani yi vutisa **Install / Not now**.
* App (2.0.0-beta.2): tindhawu ta ntirho ta **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, swikhiya swa swipfuno ku fana na eka After Effects, tikliphu ti pfuleka hi ku hatlisa, naswona OPEN yi tirha eka ti-precomp na tileyara ta ku lulamisa.

♦️ **Swi lulamisiwile**
* Swiendlakalo swa tithema leswi a swi nga ri kona eka tikhompyuta to tala ta Windows swi vuyile (swi vevuka loko swiendlakalo swa animeyixini swa Windows swi timiwile).

♦️ **Ndhawu leyi nga bohiki yo sirhelela layisense**
* Swi vutisiwa kan'we ntsena, naswona a swi bohi: hi **No thanks** hinkwaswo swi ya emahlweni swi tirha. Swi cince eka **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Yi hlayisiwa tin'hweti ta 12, a yi xavisiwi nikatsongo, naswona a yi avelaniwi na munhu, handle ka loko nawu wu swi lava.

♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 YI FIKILE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack yi rhurhela eka AutoCaptions** na switayili swa rito rin'wana na rin'wana, swivumbeko, ku famba na mipfumawulo. **UN-NEST** na timodi ta blend swi tirha eka Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** i ku tshikelela kan'we, naswona **Flex Studio (Beta)** yi pfula kliphu ya wena kusuka eka phanele.

*(Nghenisa ehenhla ka vhexini ya wena ya sweswi, kutani u sungula Premiere Pro nakambe kan'we.)*

♦️ **Leswintshwa: tikhepixini leti fambaka eka AutoCaptions**
* **Xitayili xa rito**: nyika rito rin'wana na rin'wana mivala ya rona, fonti na makumu ya Flat, Shine kumbe Glow.
* **Swivumbeko swa layini**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside na Line.
* **Ku famba ka rito rin'wana na rin'wana** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake na swin'wana) na ku langutisa ka ha ri emahlweni, ku engetela mipfumawulo ya **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Switayili swa marito na ku famba swi lava vuhumelerisi bya **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ekhilawudini, yi tirhisa tikhrediti ta Flex AI) sweswi i injini leyi bumabumeriwaka, leyi hlawuriweke kan'we eka un'wana na un'wana; hlawula injini ya Whisper ku endla tikhepixini mahala handle ka inthanete.
* **Your script** (modi ya tikhepixini): tikhepixini ti teka marito ya xikiripiti laha u vuleke marito wolawo.
* Loko ku nga hlawuriwanga nchumu (khadi ra xihlovo a ri na nchumu) yi ku nyika **thayimlayini hinkwayo**; tikhepixini ti hlayisiwa etlhelo ka phurojeke ya wena.

♦️ **Leswintshwa: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** yi landzelerisa kliphu eka app; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** yi tlherisela vulandzeleri endzhaku. A yi nghenisiwanga? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ya yi dawuniloda, kutani yi vutisa **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Leswi cinciweke**
* **AUTO CUT** yi xopaxopa kliphu leyi hlawuriweke yi tlhela yi tsema hi ku tshikelela kan'we. **Retakes** yi kuma swivulwa leswi sunguriweke nakambe.
* **Audio Studio** sweswi i tithebu-ntsongo ta tsevu. **Library** sweswi yi le ka Nest Saver.

♦️ **Swi lulamisiwile**
* **UN-NEST** eka Premiere 26.5 (a yi ala nest yin'wana na yin'wana), na timodi ta blend ku fana na Screen leti a ti tlhelela eka Normal (Premiere hi Xinghezi).
* Xikombiso xo tshwuka xa **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, ku langutisa ka ntima ka Caption Stack, na swiendlakalo swa tithema leswi a swi nga ri kona eka tikhompyuta to tala ta Windows.

♦️ **Ndhawu leyi nga bohiki yo sirhelela layisense**
* Swi vutisiwa kan'we ntsena, naswona a swi bohi: hi **No thanks** hinkwaswo swi ya emahlweni swi tirha. Swi cince eka **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Yi hlayisiwa tin'hweti ta 12, a yi xavisiwi nikatsongo, naswona a yi avelaniwi na munhu, handle ka loko nawu wu swi lava.
